confidencePolicy: Per-cell 95% Hoeffding; paired-delta range [-1,1], not simultaneous
couplingCaveat: Adding a member consumes IDs and changes enemy IDs; seeds do not promise identical random draws
seedPolicy: ROOT + (10000 + causalGroupId) * 1000 + pair, shared by all group variants
timeoutPolicy: TIMEOUT is not LOSS; comparisons use only indices complete in both variants
